review_evidence: README identifies Raylib.lean as Lean bindings to raylib/raymath/raygui; the primary tree is dominated by native graphics structures/functions/enums/FFI wrappers and executable examples.

A complete theorem-class scan found exactly five theorem declarations, all in two files: four RangeMap/UInt32 bounds in src/Raylib/Util/RangeMap.lean and one UInt32 injection bound in src/Raymath.lean. Those two files are retained.
The other 22 primary files contain zero theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations and implement graphics bindings, demos, native wrappers or Lake configuration.
